title: Paper
description: A paper, by its arXiv identifier. Metadata is arXiv's (CC0); where it is listed is the lists' (identifier, heading and line only).

arxiv_id.description: the identifier without a version (2309.02427, or cs/0112017)

comment.description: the author's comment as arXiv has it

metadata_status.description: found, or not found (arXiv returned no entry for the identifier)

repositories.description: GitHub repositories (owner/name) named in the abstract or comment

listed_in.description: each place a list names it: {listing, heading (the path of headings it sat under), line, url (the line, anchored), link (the arXiv link found there)}

repo_checks.description: what GitHub's API said of each repository: {repo, found, licence, archived, stars}

openalex_id.description: the paper's OpenAlex work id (W...), found by the DOI 10.48550/arXiv.ID

citations.description: OpenAlex's cited_by_count when it was checked

venue.description: the source name of OpenAlex's primary location, if any

citations_checked.description: the day OpenAlex was asked (YYYY-MM-DD); a paper checked in the last 30 days is not asked again

testable.description: by rule: a repository exists, its licence is permissive or LGPL, and it is not archived; unset until checked

testable_why.description: which part passed or failed, quoting the API's values

component_kind.description: what kind of component the paper presents, read from the abstract by a model: memory, planning, tool-use, reflection, skill-library, routing, multi-agent, self-improvement, evaluation, world-model, prompt-optimization, benchmark, survey or other; every value but other has the abstract span it was read from as its claim's quote

slot.description: where it would plug in here: handler, route, notes, sensor, learner (between episodes), outcome (how a run is scored) or none; quoted as component_kind is, except none

does.description: one sentence: what the component does; the abstract span it rests on is the claim's quote

result.description: the headline claim: metric, value, benchmark, compared with what; the abstract span is the claim's quote; empty when the abstract states none

needs.description: the model or models named, and anything else stated (training, data, hardware); quoted; empty when none

record_by.description: the model that read the abstract into these fields, and when: MODEL at YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

record_hash.description: which model and which instructions read it (a hash): a paper read with the same pair is not read again

trial.description: the queue of papers to try: queued, running, replicated, not replicated or dropped; who set it is the claim's author

trial_why.description: why the paper was queued, dropped, or given its result
